title: biscutella fontqueri subsp. cardonica
intro: Biscutella fontqueri subsp. cardonica, commonly known as Cardona's biscutella, is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae. It is an annual herb that has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its medicinal properties. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various health issues such as wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Biscutella fontqueri subsp. cardonica include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
